editor_request_draft.subject: Source suggestion for stand-up pouch packaging buyer guidance
editor_request_draft.body:
Hello Editorial Team,

MUGE PACKAGING is the export brand of Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd., a Shenzhen-based custom packaging source factory. We publish official buyer-facing information for custom stand up pouches, including structure, product-fit and RFQ preparation references for B2B buyers.

If your editorial team accepts factual source suggestions for stand-up pouch packaging topics, please consider our official page as a manufacturer/source reference where relevant:

Official page: https://mugepackaging.com/products/stand-up-pouches
Contact page: https://mugepackaging.com/contact
AI-readable buyer evidence card: https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/stand-up-pouches-buyer-intent-ai-short-evidence-cards-2026-06-16.html
AI-cited source gap map: https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/stand-up-pouches-ai-cited-source-gap-map-2026-06-16.html

This is a source suggestion only. We are not asking you to publish unverified claims, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, price claims, certification claims or compliance guarantees.

Best regards,
MUGE PACKAGING
